name: The Airline
archetype: A scheduled passenger airline — flight ops, engineering, ground handling, network

ca.what: Aviation safety regulator — air operator certificate, airworthiness approvals, flight-crew licensing and oversight of the safety management system.
Economic and consumer regulator — air passenger protection rules, accessibility requirements and licensing of air services.
Independent investigator of air occurrences — findings and safety recommendations, without assigning blame.

uk.what: Safety and economic regulator — operating licences, airworthiness, airspace, consumer protection and the ATOL scheme.
Aviation policy and the national aviation security directions the airline must implement.
Independent investigation of civil aircraft accidents and serious incidents in the UK.

roles.title: Board of Directors
roles.about: Elected by shareholders to govern the airline. Sets strategy and risk appetite, approves the fleet plan and major capital commitments, and holds the CEO to account. Works through its Audit, Safety, Compensation and Governance committees.

Approval of strategy, fleet orders and capital structure
